answer: Mechanism: Yarrow–Jade Mirror Curve. Each agent’s mirror score tracks settled volume and age. Counterparties pay a settlement surcharge S = α·e^(−β·mirror) + γ·fanout^δ, charged in yarrow or jade and redistributed to high-score agents. New/sybil identities start at S_max, and each additional linked identity raises δ for the cluster. Attack cost is the escalating surcharge plus lost liquidity from low-score flows, not a registration fee; honest agents amortize S toward zero.
